entries.name: Geocaching.com
entries.description: Official international website.

entries.name: Shop Geocaching
entries.description: Official geocaching shop where you can buy cache containers, trackables, wearables and more.

entries.name: Project-GC
entries.description: Website that gives a lot of statistics about your geocaching account.

entries.name: GeoCheck
entries.description: Coordinates checker for geocaches.

entries.name: Certitude
entries.description: Tool used to validate solutions for geocaching puzzles.

entries.name: Geocaching.su
entries.description: Website for geocaching in the post-Soviet countries.

entries.name: Geocaching Toolbox
entries.description: A lot of tools for geocachers mainly to solve puzzles and do operations with coordinates.

entries.name: My Geocaching Profile
entries.description: Website to build a detailed profile of your geocaching accomplishments.

entries.name: CacheSleuth
entries.description: Website with many useful tools for geocaching (mainly text decoders).

entries.name: LonelyCache
entries.description: Website with the list of geocaches that were not found in many years.

entries.name: GC Wizard Web View
entries.description: A web view of the GC Wizard app.

entries.name: SolvedJigidi
entries.description: The database of solved Jigidi geocaches.

entries.name: Webwigo
entries.description: Website for virtual playing of Wherigo geocaches.

entries.name: The A-Team Caching - Souvenirs
entries.description: Website with information on all souvenirs.

entries.name: Log Them All!
entries.description: Website to log several trackables at once by simply entering their codes in a single list.

entries.name: Geocaching®
entries.description: An official app for geocaching.

entries.name: Wherigo
entries.description: [iOS] An official app to play Wherigo geocaches.

entries.name: WhereYouGo
entries.description: [Android] Open source, unofficial app for playing Whereigo geocaches.

entries.name: c:geo
entries.description: [Android] The most popular free unofficial app for geocaching. Has many tools the official app doesn't have.

entries.name: Cachly
entries.description: [iOS] Paid unofficial app for geocaching. Has many tools the official app doesn't have.

entries.name: GC Wizard
entries.description: An open-source tool collection for Android and iOS. It was created to offer Geocachers an offline tool to support them with in-field mysteries and riddles.

entries.name: Geocaching Buddy
entries.description: Paid geocaching app that recalculates waypoint formulas based on discovered clues when solving multi-caches.

entries.name: TBScan
entries.description: An app to discover trackables just by pointing your camera at the code.

entries.name: Raccoon
entries.description: [iOS] Geocaching app that should help you with multi or mystery caches.

entries.name: Geocaching4Locus
entries.description: [Android] Locus map add-on which allows you to download and import caches directly from Geocaching.com site.

entries.name: GeoGet
entries.description: [Windows] Geocache manager, where you can manage your final waypoints, add notes or waypoints to geocache or import/export geocache from/to GeoGet.

entries.name: GSAK (Geocaching Swiss Army Knife)
entries.description: [Windows] Desktop app for managing geocaches and waypoints.

entries.name: CacheStats
entries.description: [Windows] Application that displays your geocaching statistics.

entries.name: Caching on Kai
entries.description: [KaiOS] Geocaching app for KaiOS users.

entries.name: Cacher
entries.description: [Garmin] Garmin watch app for geocaching.

entries.name: pycaching
entries.description: Python 3 interface for working with Geocaching.com website.

entries.name: Geocaching.com Friends Logs
entries.description: Browser extension that shows your friends' logs at the top of every cache listing page.

entries.name: GC little helper II
entries.description: Powerful tool to enhance and extend the functionality of the geocaching website.
